source_note: 2018年实拍，保留五间、四根外露柱与两端墙面，中央门、两侧窗及低台阶。
prompt: Create a meticulous but airy architectural line plate of the actual Dacheng Hall at the COUNTY Confucian Temple in Zhengding, based on photo2. Style master photo1 is Longmen contour drawing only. Straight frontal view, exactly FIVE bays, with central door; barred windows only in the two adjacent bays; two outer bays infilled masonry with broad blank inset rectangular panels. Preserve the four visible front timber columns dividing central3bays, while outermost structural columns are enclosed in masonry; do not expose6round columns. One broad single hip-and-gable roof, two curly ridge-end ornaments, NO central finial. Widely spaced simple large brackets with horizontal layered beam contours, not busy Qing clusters. Low broad stone terrace with small 3-step central stair, no railings. Preserve distinctive outer brick panel wall arrangement. Remove buildings, vegetation, signs, people, all lettering, vertical banners. Only a small blank vertical plaque outline under center eave. Very fine black contour on clean white, as master, no tone, no shaded roof, no hatching, no black openings; sparse tile-flow strokes, sparse brick joints. Full complete hall within8% side margins and15% top/bottom white; landscape1536x1024.

site_recommendation.name: 正定县文庙大成殿
site_recommendation.lede: 低缓屋面覆盖着五间殿堂，粗大的梁栱在檐下显露。正定县文庙大成殿的年代，来自结构形制判断，而非后来文庙建置的纪年。
facts: 大成殿通常断为晚唐至五代，全国重点文物保护单位年代列五代。
面阔五间、进深三间，单檐歇山顶；外侧柱被墙体包裹，正面可见四根柱身。
本条为县文庙大成殿，与正定府文庙不同；不采用明洪武年间的文庙建置年给古殿断代。
